# Axomiya IT Labs

> A bilingual (English/Assamese) open-source community focused on AI, language technology, and developer education in Assam.

Axomiya IT Labs shares practical AI and open-source education, projects, and community updates rooted in Assam. English pages are the authoritative content while Assamese translations are being prepared.

- [Blog index](https://axomiya-it-labs.github.io/blog/)
